description: Source code for the implementation of SystemMode functionalities in a software plugin, including initialization, state management, client activation/deactivation, and file handling.

classes.name: SystemModeImplementation
classes.description: Implements system mode control, including request and retrieval of system state, client management, and file interactions.

methods.name: SystemModeImplementation::RequestState
methods.description: Requests a change in state for a specified system mode.

methods.name: SystemModeImplementation::GetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified system mode.

methods.name: SystemModeImplementation::ClientActivated
methods.description: Activates a client plugin for a specific system mode.

methods.name: SystemModeImplementation::ClientDeactivated
methods.description: Deactivates a client plugin for a specific system mode.
